title: Dub – The Modern Link Attribution Platform
description: Clean, modern developer tool with a dark/light toggle. Uses a centered hero with bold typography and a floating UI mockup. Feature grid with icon cards and subtle border effects. Pink accent color against dark navy background creates a distinctive brand identity. The live site uses a hero_mockup, feature_grid, pricing, testimonials, cta structure with strong visual hierarchy and smooth scroll-triggered animations throughout. Navigation is clean and unobtrusive. The color palette and typography work together to create a cohesive brand experience that aligns with the product category.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for dub-style products.
style_vibe: Clean, modern developer tool with a dark/light toggle.
